durability_goal: Prepare stable first-party ad containers and fail-closed behaviour so future approved ads do not break the citation workflow if an ad network is unavailable.
activation_model: Inactive by default. Future activation must update this config, privacy disclosures, CSP/headers, provider identifiers, and perform a production ad review before enabling third-party ad scripts.
principles: No third-party ad scripts without explicit approval
No ads inside active citation form fields, generated citation output, copy/download controls, validation messages, or trust explanations
Ad containers must fail closed when config is missing, malformed, inactive, blocked, or unsupported
No backend, database, account system, or paid infrastructure required for ad readiness
Ad layout must reserve safe vertical space only when ads are intentionally enabled
Ad activation must preserve citation performance, accessibility, privacy, and user trust
Do not make citation accuracy or legal information dependent on an ad network

slots.max_density: one primary display slot above guide links
slots.placement_guardrail: Never insert inside the form, citation preview, validation, or explanation panel.

slots.max_density: one low-priority display slot near bottom of homepage
slots.placement_guardrail: Must not interrupt the user while creating or copying a citation.

slots.max_density: one guide-page display slot near article end
slots.placement_guardrail: Must not appear before the core answer of a guide page.

failure_behavior: If ads-config.json cannot be fetched, all revenue slots stay hidden.
If ads_active is false, all revenue slots stay hidden.
If a slot is not listed or not active, that slot stays hidden.
If an approved provider is missing, slots stay hidden.
If a third-party network fails, citation functionality remains unaffected.
